soldier: Body medium-sized; head yellow, the antennal ridges reddish yellow, the pronotum pale yellow, the mandibles reddish brown, the abdomen and legs yellowish white. The head has very few setae; the labrum has eight to ten long bristles on each side; setae on the periphery of the pronotum very few and still fewer in the middle region; the abdominal tergites with rather numerous scattered bristles. Head rectangular, the lateral margins of the middle section almost parallel, slightly contracted in front of the antennal sockets and near the posterior end, the posterior margin slightly straight. Labrum elongate-lingulate, longer than wide, the middle section gradually contracting forwards. Mandibles rather straight, the apices slightly curved. The tooth of the left mandible lies more than one-third from the anterior end. Antennae with 15–16 segments; with 15 segments segment 3 is the shortest, with 16 segments segment 4 is the shortest. Postmentum rectangular, the waist narrower anteriorly, the lateral margins parallel from the waist backwards. On each side of the anterior margin of the pronotum there is a very deep muscle-scar depression, exactly at the position where the anterior half rises vertically, and there is a distinct notch at the exact middle of both the anterior and the posterior margin.
worker: Distinctly dimorphic, with a large and a small form. Apart from being larger, darker in colour and having one more antennal segment, the large form agrees with the small form in all other characters.
